rows.what: Historical planet-scoring worker and planet-rarity setting (separated from kept biome identity).

rows.serves: separate optional system or prohibited historical worldgen
rows.why: Designer decision: No worldgen in any version is the standing rule and the explicit brief; historical universal-planet worker/rarity promises do not authorize an alternative planet. Recommend permanent inert retention, not a next-version option.

rows.what: Tagged hardened, rich, grass, mud and liquid slime terrain provide movement, fertility and contact surfaces.
rows.called_by: BiomeDef.terrainsByFertility and terrainPatchMakers; SlimeUtility.IsBeingRead; ExplosiveGrowth Slime top; FlowWorks slip/liquid patches
rows.serves: ordinary land, life and the contact/material bargain
rows.why: Designer decision: Without firm shelves, slow soft ground and liquid channels the player cannot read where to build or traverse the body. All body ground remains contact-active, including hardened ground.

rows.what: Slime grass, bellows, thumbstalk and readerbloom furnish the native pseudo-plant ecology and harvests.
rows.called_by: BiomeDef.wildPlants; vanilla Plant jobs; ExplosiveGrowth roster Slime tops
rows.serves: ordinary land, life and the contact/material bargain
rows.why: Designer decision: Grass feeds grazers, bellows supplies harvestable raw material, thumbstalk and readerbloom supply ordinary vegetation and silhouettes, with no custom quest or extraction bonus. Deleting ordinary growth, grazing and harvest removes life and the material input.

rows.what: Resistant gelatid herd creature supplies the visible slime ecology and Titanoslime shedding product.
rows.called_by: BiomeDef.wildAnimals; vanilla grazing/predation; optional next-version titan shedding
rows.serves: ordinary land, life and the contact/material bargain
rows.why: Designer decision: The harmless resistant herd is the ordinary grazer and prey population; deleting grazing/resistance leaves the wrong food chain.

rows.what: Lesser, ordinary and greater oomb roster, resistant identity and ordinary refuse feeding; advancement/fission separate.
rows.called_by: BiomeDef.wildAnimals; VEF EatWeirdFood and RM_Oomb_VEFThinkTree patch; EnvironmentalHazards death worker
rows.serves: ordinary land, life and the contact/material bargain
rows.why: Designer decision: Keep lesser, ordinary and greater oombs and refuse-eating: removing their scavenging eliminates the named scavenger role and its tame utility. Advancement/fission is separately inventoried, not hidden in this row.

rows.what: Wuum substrate creature resists the body and carries acid death burst and optional VEF asexual reproduction.
rows.called_by: BiomeDef.wildAnimals; VEF AsexualReproduction; EnvironmentalHazards death worker
rows.serves: ordinary land, life and the contact/material bargain
rows.why: Designer decision: Keep the substrate creature, bite and ordinary reproduction: without reproduction a genderless species has no natural renewal. Its VEF cloning is an ordinary reproductive route, not a separate reward mechanic; capped shared-framework behaviour is modelled.

rows.what: Lesser, ordinary and greater gappos are resistant native filter-feeders.
rows.called_by: BiomeDef.wildAnimals; vanilla grazing; greater race comp also calls deferred GappoChannel
rows.serves: ordinary land, life and the contact/material bargain
rows.why: Designer decision: Keep lesser, ordinary and greater filter-feeders with ordinary feeding; removing grazing loses the filter-feeder role. Channel hardening is independently deferred.

rows.what: A greater gappo hardens eligible non-liquid slime ground and clears slime smear while grazing, under a setting.
rows.called_by: Gappo.xml greater ThingDef -> RM_CompGappoChannel.CompTickRare -> terrain replacement and filth Destroy
rows.serves: separate optional system or prohibited historical worldgen
rows.why: Designer decision: The feeder remains a feeder if it stops paving and cleaning; terrain engineering is a secondary utility, not required land or signature.

rows.what: Dwommo has actual flight fields, animation frames and a grounding setting.

rows.serves: ordinary land, life and the contact/material bargain
rows.why: Designer decision: Removing real flight contradicts the fictional floater and the flyer ruling. Keep native resistance and actual tracker flight; no new sky system.

rows.what: Fubbum is a resistant predator with a hunting toggle.
rows.called_by: Fubbum.xml predator/size flags; FubbumHunting.Apply; vanilla predator jobs
rows.serves: ordinary land, life and the contact/material bargain
rows.why: Designer decision: Without hunting the native predator has no ordinary ecological role. Vanilla prey choice applies; do not promise gelatid-only prey or adult-colonist safety for smaller children.

rows.what: Neighbour-biome fauna arrive partly slimified through a generation seed and capped ongoing trickle, filtered away from hostile arrivals.

rows.serves: ordinary land, life and the contact/material bargain
rows.why: Designer decision: Susceptible outsiders make the boundary between native resistance and absorption visible. Remove them and a native-only map cannot show that encounter. Keep bounded arrivals, no load-time reseeding.

rows.what: Contact with tagged slime ground applies film to flesh pawns, including colonists, subject to identity/gene resistance.

rows.serves: ordinary land, life and the contact/material bargain
rows.why: Designer decision: Touch is the causal input of the material bargain; deleting contact removes its price. Must work independently of deferred archive recording.

rows.what: Staged film slows and impairs a pawn, suppresses panic from half-absorption, progresses at the configured ordinary or injected rate and reaches dissolution.
rows.called_by: HediffComp_Slimification.CompPostTickInterval -> RM_SlimeLadder.Check/RatePerDay; SlimeIngestion; titan release
rows.serves: ordinary land, life and the contact/material bargain
rows.why: Designer decision: Without progressive impairment and lethal completion contact has no escalating cost. The same ordinary ladder charges raw consumption and engulf release.

rows.what: Early film wipes off off-body. Later ordinary film holds in normal country. Tagged drying biomes reverse film for map and caravan context.
rows.called_by: HediffComp_Slimification.SeverityChangePerDay -> SlimeUtility.BiomeOf -> DryingBiomeExtension; caravan Tile context
rows.serves: ordinary land, life and the contact/material bargain
rows.why: Designer decision: Deleting early wipe-off, advanced-film hold and drying reversal makes the signature an unavoidable death sentence or a trivial step-off cure; the map answer is explicitly owner-authored.

rows.what: Terminal film kills without leaving its corpse, yields slime and smear, and drops gear and carried inventory through the corrected destruction path.
rows.called_by: HediffComp_Slimification.Dissolve; titan Digest; vanilla Kill/Corpse.Strip/Destroy
rows.serves: ordinary land, life and the contact/material bargain

rows.serves: ordinary land, life and the contact/material bargain

rows.serves: ordinary land, life and the contact/material bargain
rows.why: Designer decision: No local quarry is a land law; deleting compression removes renewable local stone. Keep a normal recipe and usable block output with imported bootstrap materials.

rows.serves: ordinary land, life and the contact/material bargain
rows.why: Designer decision: Without normal slime-to-meal processing the food branch cannot become a managed routine without repeated raw-dose charges. Keep this base bill, separately from gourmet solvent bills.

rows.serves: separate optional system or prohibited historical worldgen
rows.why: Designer decision: Rendering toxipotatoes, twisted meat and ambrosyx is a cross-biome cuisine utility. Removing it leaves raw-slime meals and stone intact.
